narratives.title: Proof travels with the claim
narratives.body: Applied AI is most useful when the work, outcome, time window, and evidence can be followed together.

narratives.title: Teach
narratives.body: Build practical learning systems that help people move from AI concepts to working evaluations, prompts, and agents.

narratives.title: Build
narratives.body: Ship product surfaces and open-source infrastructure that make experimental AI workflows easier to operate.

narratives.title: Convene
narratives.body: Create technical programs where practitioners can learn, test ideas, and connect work to measurable program outcomes.

narratives.title: Outside the work
narratives.body: A consent-aware view of what Anish watches, reads, and moves through: owner-authorized MyAnimeList and Hardcover syncs, with Strava loaded only through official public embeds after visitor intent.

narratives.title: How to read the numbers
narratives.body: Public counts come from the public inventory. Internal outcomes are deliberately rounded, dated, qualified, and separated from revenue or individual-causality claims.
